summary: DeepSeek released an experimental multimodal variant, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, on its API platform along with a new Files API for image uploads.

practices.reason: The model adds multimodal agent capability claimed to approach a rival frontier model, but the comparison is the lab's own unreplicated benchmark.
practices.quote: On multimodal agent benchmarks, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp makes a major leap over V4-Flash, bringing multimodal agent performance close to Opus-4.8.

practices.reason: Teams need to switch model names, handle image tokenization for billing, and adopt the new multimodal API surface to use the model.
practices.quote: Images are tokenized for billing: up to 384 tokens each, at V4-Flash pricing

practices.reason: The new Files API lets engineers upload an image once and reuse it by reference, cutting repeated upload bandwidth for multimodal requests.
practices.quote: Upload an image once, then reference it by file_id to save request bandwidth
